verdict.rationale: DBOS has a first-party testing tutorial for unit-testing workflows, steps, and transactions with pytest or unittest. It also documents self-hosting Conductor and the DBOS Console on a development machine via Docker Compose, which gives a local, non-production environment. Neither source explicitly describes a sandbox that isolates test runs from production data. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or isolated test-database capability, documentation that tests avoid production data, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Because DBOS workflows, steps, and transactions are ordinary Python functions, you can unit test them using any Python testing framework, like pytest or unittest.
you can self-host Conductor and the DBOS Console on your development machine using Docker Compose.
